title: Intake Prune-and-Stitch — Sprint Planning & Light Groom
summary: Working notes for a lightweight backlog prune + stitch session focused on intake noise, small UX wins, and two high-impact console cuts for Sprint 31. Goal: free up 1.5 engineer-weeks by removing/deferring low-signal items and deliver two quick telemetry-driven fixes.
decisions: Adopt lightweight scoring for intake items (see rubric below)
Defer feature requests with no telemetry/enterprise ask >90 days
Prioritize two targeted fixes: dashboard query latency (CON-4123) and noisy rollout error banner (CON-4178)
Reserve one half-day design spike for wireframe match to reduce rework
intake_notes: Context: recent onboarding sessions + support queue show 3 repeated asks about dashboard table filters and slow query response. Telemetry shows 35% of dashboard queries spike >300ms during peak. We ran a quick audit of open intake items tagged 'dashboard' and 'filter' and found a large tail of low-clarity tickets (30+ tickets) that likely can be consolidated or closed.
prio_rubric: Score components (0-5 each): user-pain (product/CS reports), telemetry-signal (observability spikes), cost-impact (ops/GPU spend), dev-effort (lower favorable). Composite: user-pain*2 + telemetry*1.5 + cost-impact - dev-effort. Thresholds: >=10 fast-track, 6-9 consider, <=5 defer/close.
wireframe_impressions: Dashboard filter chip: current flow requires two clicks; proposal compresses to one-click inline toggle (saves ~1.2s per common query).
Rollout page error banner: noisy and persistent — wireframe proposes transient toast + 'details' affordance to reduce noise and support ops triage.
Model selection modal: suggestion to add recent models MRU list to reduce cognitive load for power users.
Quick actions bar: keep but hide advanced options behind kebab menu to reduce visual clutter.
sprint_plan: Sprint 31 (Nov 8 - Nov 21): commit scope = 2 small fixes + 1 grooming pass. 1) Fix CON-4123 dashboard query latency: backend router hint + front-end debounce; estimate 3 dev-days + 1 QA day. 2) Fix CON-4178 noisy rollout banner: new toast component + analytics event; estimate 2 dev-days + 0.5 QA. 3) Intake prune session: consolidate 30 low-clarity tickets into 5 canonical tickets; estimate 2 PM-days + 1 eng-day. Contingency: if backend work blocks, deliver wireframe-only for product/design handoff (no dev time spent). Aim: ship both fixes by Sprint end and reduce backlog by ~30 items.
open_questions: Do we need a feature flag for rollback on the banner change?
Should consolidated backlog tickets include sample JQL and representative user quotes?
Do infra SREs want a follow-up spike on query caching impact?
action_items: Ava: schedule 90-min prune session with PMs + triage EMs (by Nov 6)
Marcus: prototype one-click filter wireframe (by Nov 4)
Diego: estimate backend router hint feasibility and risk (by Nov 5)
Leah: prepare consolidation doc with examples to link to consolidated tickets (by Nov 6)
